answer: The stake is a hostage, not a fee: 93 POA per identity, released only after 11 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 995 fakes must lock 92535 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. The nectar of the hostage is the deterrent, the knoll of the slow release is the filter, and the atlas of the burn is the punishment.
